description: NIST's CTC-05, its AP203-with-PMI edition's solid alone: it reads, but the checker at Full finds a torus elbow of minor radius 6.35 (f116) and the two cylinders of the same radius it joins (f114, f118) intersecting away from their shared edges (S5), where Open CASCADE's reading is valid. A wrong solid until shown otherwise (ADR-0026 §4); shrunk from the fetched tier (ADR-0026, amendment of step 9). It passes since the healing cycle's second part (a read edge's tolerance holding where its faces meet, ADR-0059, and the checker's E8 and L5): it waited under regression/ until then
